description: MASTERSPIKE — a model that carries the Master role and the llm-wiki knowledge format, selectable as an agent, without ever being able to sign anything (peer PLAN Step 7). The artifacts are generated by peer-node/scripts/sparknet-masterspike.py from .opencode/skills/llm-wiki/SKILL.md; the source skill is the single source of truth, and switching inference backends cannot silently drop the format. Read by peer-node/tests/test_masterspike.py, which fails the build if the artifacts are edited by hand, drift from the skill, or the skill moves.

artifacts.generated_from: the one source skill; both backends embed the byte-identical format body
artifacts.build: make model-generate (regenerate) / make model-verify (fail on divergence) / make model-build / make model-serve (both need a running Ollama daemon)

signing_boundary.structural: the artifacts are text: no key material, no signer socket, no state dir; the model mounts no signing surface
signing_boundary.why: authority is Ed25519 in the Master, never a prompt — a prompt cannot produce a signature the registry would accept, and the model is not wired to anything that could.

not_built_yet: The Modelfile and the vLLM prompt artifact are committed and verified against their source; the Ollama model itself is not created on this host (no running `ollama` daemon — `make model-build`/`model-serve` are target-node steps). Creating and serving the model, selecting it in a live Open WebUI, and confirming it answers with the llm-wiki format is `DoD: confirm: user`.
